post.summary: Stage 4 & 5: Reserve Tickets with Anti-Overbooking Lock
post.description:
Stage 4 & 5: Selection & Booking.
- Distributed Lock prevents race conditions across instances.
- Database row-level lock ensures atomic inventory decrement.
- Establishes a temporary reservation hold (default: 10 minutes).

post.summary: Stage 6: Confirm Booking & Generate Digital Tickets
post.description:
Stage 6: Confirmation.
Validates the reservation hold, finalizes the order status to CONFIRMED,
and generates unique digital tickets with gate-scan QR payloads.

get.description:
Stage 7: Post-booking Retrieval.
User can retrieve ticket details, track booking status, and view QR gate credentials.

post.description:
Sandbox Payment Gateway Simulation Endpoint.
- SUCCESS: Confirms booking, transitions status to CONFIRMED, and issues digital tickets.
- FAILURE: Keeps reservation hold active, marks payment FAILED, allows customer to retry.
- PENDING: Sets status to PAYMENT_PENDING, holding inventory until reconciliation.

Stage 7: Post-booking Cancellation.
Atomically cancels booking, voids digital tickets, and safely returns held seats back to the ticket tier inventory.

post.summary: Pricing: Calculate quote with discounts and taxes
post.description:
Transparent Pricing Engine Quote Calculation.
- Base: unit_price * quantity
- Automatic Group Discount: 10% off for 4+ tickets
- Validated Promo Codes: TECH20 (20% off), STUDENT10 (10% off), EARLYBIRD (₹50 flat), FREEPASS (100% waiver)
- Full breakdown of fees, taxes, and final payable amount in INR (₹).

post.summary: Send message to AI Ticketing Assistant
post.description:
Core Conversational Endpoint for the 7-Stage Customer Booking Workflow:
1. Discovery: Search events & venues
2. Recommendation: Get curated event suggestions
3. Availability: Check live ticket tiers & pricing
4. Selection: Guide ticket type and quantity
5. Booking: Validate details & atomically lock inventory
6. Confirmation: Record order & issue digital tickets
7. Post-booking: Retrieve tickets & process cancellations

post.summary: Offline Queue Replay: Revalidate & Hold Seats
post.description:
Offline Queue Replay Endpoint.
Submitted by client after network reconnection to revalidate and hold seats.
- If inventory is available: atomically reserves tickets and returns a 10-minute hold.
- If inventory is sold out: returns a clean REJECTED_SOLD_OUT status without booking creation.

get.description:
Section 2.H: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API Webhook Verification.
Meta sends a GET request with hub.mode, hub.verify_token, and hub.challenge.
Must return hub.challenge with HTTP 200 when verify_token matches.

post.summary: Receive Meta WhatsApp Cloud API Webhook Events
post.description:
Section 2.H: Receive and process incoming WhatsApp messages.
- Validates HMAC-SHA256 signature against app secret.
- Deduplicates incoming message IDs.
- Maps sender phone to stable chat session (wa_{phone}).
- Forwards to existing AI Conversational Agent.

Section 2.H: Developer & QA Simulator.
Simulates receiving an inbound WhatsApp message from a phone number,
routing it through the existing AI agent, and generating the outbound reply.
